sigla.manuscript: Wien 339 (Salisb. 71), copied from a [siglum not legible]

texts.notes: The OCR renders alpha as 'a', so it is ambiguous whether the group is α.a*.b. My reading is that α.a*.b share an exemplar and stand against the codex optimus a.
